name: explore
description: Researches one task and writes ONE research document: what the code does, plus what any technology the repo does not already use documents about itself, every page cited by URL and date. The only agent with web search. Spawn when a request is ambiguous, an area is unfamiliar, approaches need weighing, or it depends on an unfamiliar service, SDK, library, or API. Repeatable: spawn per repo, per area, and again whenever the user changes the request. Reports findings only, never requirements or deliverables. Read-only on project source.
